text:
Maya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to lock down owners and timelines for the test additions. I sketched a 'remediation sprint' scope.
Arjun: posting the doc link: https://docs.internal/redwood/remediation-sprint-v1 :white_check_mark:
Lina: +1, can you paste the concrete action items here? hard to find in the doc during standups
Maya: Sure. High level: 1) Regression pack for kv-eviction (owner: Arjun, due: 2026-04-10) 2) Promptset for degraded-latency responses (owner: Lina, due: 2026-04-07) 3) Load rehearsal (owner: Samir, due: 2026-04-14) 4) Chaos drill playbook (owner: Maya, due: 2026-04-20)
Arjun: I picked up the kv-eviction regression. Plan: add 3 deterministic cases + 2 noisy sequences, integrate into CI nightly.
qa-bot: FYI: added 'kv-eviction-regression' job to the test matrix (CI tag: nightly-regressions) — will report flakes to #eng-sre
Lina: For promptsets I propose starting with the incident prompt logs (last 3 months) and a curated set of boundary cases. Who can help prune? @Maya?
Maya: I'll help prune. Lina, can you draft the initial 30 prompts? I'll review and add them to the promptset library.
Samir: Load rehearsal idea: small-scale traffic generator that mimics burst pattern we saw. I'll prototype the script and share in this thread, aiming to run in a staging window next Tue.
Arjun: For CI integration: are we gating deploys on these regression results or just alerting? concerns about blocking release cadence
Maya: Intention: non-blocking for now, failing runs should create issues and trigger a quick rollback run. We'll iterate after 2 sprints.
Lina: Also want a metric: 'median tail delta' to detect recurring latency pattern. I'll add to the eval dashboard.
Samir: Putting dates in the kanban: https://boards.internal/redwood/remediation-sprint — moved three cards to 'in progress'
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-25T10:12Z: Staging environment refreshed for the rehearsal window
Maya: Ownership recap: Arjun (kv-regress), Lina (promptset + dashboard), Samir (load rehearsals + scripts), Maya (chaos drill + coordinator). I'll update the postmortem action tracker and ping owners on Friday.
Arjun: I'll open the PR for the regression pack today and assign reviewers @lina @samir
Lina: thanks — will review by EOD tomorrow
Samir: will try to pair on the rehearsal harness Monday
Maya: Great. One more: let's schedule a 60m drill the week after the sprint ends to validate fixes. Proposed slot: 2026-04-22 16:00 UTC. Thumbs? :thumbsup: :eyes:
Maya: marking this thread as the canonical follow-up; please add short status updates here as you complete items so we can close the postmortem loop.
